title: Who is click-web for?
question: Click Web already exists as the Next.js companion to the Click mobile app (joinclick.co): landing and waitlist, authenticated dashboard (chat, map, events, LiveKit), and Click for Business insights. Init will write PRODUCT.md from confirmed product truth — not a visual direction. Which audience should future design work treat as primary?

options.label: People who met in the room
options.thesis: Primary user is someone who already connected in person and is continuing that relationship on the web.
options.body: Dashboard, chat, map, events, QR, and calls. Insights stays real but secondary. Marketing exists to get them into the app and onto the web companion.
options.case: Matches README: web is the consumer dashboard plus HTTP BFF; mobile owns the handshake.

options.label: Venues and promoters
options.thesis: Primary user is a local venue, promoter, or event operator proving who actually showed up together.
options.body: Insights, heatmaps, tribes, vibe radar, social sticky score, beacons. Consumer dashboard exists but is not the design north star for this repo.
options.case: Matches README: web-only B2B surface; mobile produces the verified data.

options.label: Two-sided, equally first-class
options.thesis: click-web has two primary jobs and neither may be treated as a side quest.
options.body: Personal dashboard for people continuing verified connections, and Click for Business for operators reading verified social topology. Anonymous landing and public events serve both.
options.case: Matches the shipped surface split: / for people, /insights for operators, /events public.

options.label: Anonymous visitors first
options.thesis: The primary job of this repo right now is converting visitors who have not yet joined.
options.body: Landing, playground, waitlist, public events. Authenticated and B2B surfaces exist but are not the product-truth center for upcoming design work.
options.case: Root / must SSR marketing for anonymous requests; app is not publicly launched until NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_LAUNCHED.
